title: Item Disguise Command
description: This mod adds a simple mod that allows you disguise items as other items in creative, WORKS ON ALL SERVERS 1.21.2+
body:
# Item Disguise Command

A lightweight client-side mod that lets you visually disguise any item you're holding using a simple command.

## Features
- All players can see the disguise
- Easy-to-use command: `//itemdisguise`
- No server installation required
- Works on all servers
- Command runs client side
- Compatible with Minecraft **1.21.2+**
- Only requires Creative Mode

## How It Works
Hold the item you want to disguise in your hand, then run the command with the item you want it to appear as.

## Usage
```
//itemdisguise <item>
```

## Example
```
//itemdisguise minecraft:diamond
```

This will make the item you're holding appear as a diamond.
